There are no top-level shell commands, eval statements, curl/wget invocations, or data exfiltration attempts present in the global scope. The functions `build()` and `package()` are defined but not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`, so their contents are out of scope for this safety gate. Overall, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of arbitrary code execution or unintended side effects.
</details>
